material_findings.claim: The head plan now separates preflight authority/custody from postflight successor comparisons.
material_findings.consequence: A numerically acyclic plan could still demand completed head/successor evidence before creating the components.
material_findings.next_test: Freeze actual completed baseline source/candidate-base and retained-gain slices, then verify each selected worker assignment references only those preflight states.
material_findings.rationale: MB-T001 dependencies use MB-T015 preflight and MB-T062 monitor. Component edges to MB-T001 now explicitly mean selected authority/owned plan, not completed head. Eight-view/whole-bird/successor-preservation remain postflight obligations. MB-T013 is bounded by the series preflight source/feature/candidate-base definition. No future candidate bytes are required to authorize their creation.

material_findings.claim: The resource controller defines an unambiguous80% stop threshold.
material_findings.consequence: Two implementations could stop at20%consumed versus80%consumed, changing the available work and expected safety reserve by a factor of four.
material_findings.next_test: Write the exact consumed-token/time comparisons and remaining reserve in the monitor ledger; if80%consumed is intended, no-new-call thresholds are9600generatedoutput,400000provider-total and36elapsed minutes, subject to earlier visible-gain stop. Exercise both sides of each threshold in the harmless drill.
material_findings.rationale: Headroom commonly names remaining allowance; the artifact never specifies whether80% refers to consumed or remaining. This is a correction before dispatch, not an observed cap overrun or source/model failure.

material_findings.claim: The new45-minute/12000output/500000provider-total packet is feasible and operationally enforceable now.
material_findings.consequence: Provisional ceilings could be mistaken for verified runtime capability or a spending target.
material_findings.next_test: Complete MB-T062 with actual counter schema/availability and freshness, per-worker root/QC/preflight/render/export allocations, sampled stop/interrupt latency, and a harmless synthetic breach. If reliable counters/controller are unavailable, do not dispatch and report partial.
material_findings.rationale: Output and cached-inclusive provider totals are now separate explicit units; no billing or hard-enforcement claim survives. But six head subcaps of4000output each would total24000 if all spent, before root/QC/evidence. The shared rule forbids adding them; a selected feasible suballocation is still missing. Rendering mandatory all-era/eight-view evidence and monitor work must fit the45-minute shared scope.60-second polling and80%reserve can reduce risk but cannot prove no overrun without measuring counter and interruption latency.

material_findings.claim: The next tasks are falsifiable against source-supported outcomes rather than task or artifact counts.
evidence: MB-T002–012 regional source pairs and full-image evidence
material_findings.consequence: A worker could close tasks from successful builds, more objects or altered tone without repairing source identity.
material_findings.next_test: Before dispatch bind each selected source feature/view to the frozen candidate and two-attempt visible-gain rule; independent QC records discrepancy and useful gain at whole-bird scale.
material_findings.rationale: Closure requires matched source/candidate images, estimated-camera disclosure, source scope, exact files and owner authority. Strict normal FAIL is diagnosed with unchanged thresholds rather than relaxed. Root may obtain scoped partial head direction with parityUNKNOWN/normalFAIL; full per-era finish/acceptance is outside the45-minute head packet. No numerical metrology or final likeness is invented.

material_findings.claim: Complete requirements coverage remains stage-aware and does not impose superseded engineering gates.
material_findings.consequence: Future mechanics or full-product tests could block a bounded appearance checkpoint, or missing tests could become fabricated failures.
material_findings.next_test: Select only applicable current tasks and name later authorization/unknowns; retain full B11 encounter/power-processing/copy evidence when its future phase is selected.
material_findings.rationale: Head source impact leads; appearance/finish precede separately authorized mechanics. Invisible nondistracting CG intersections remain permitted. Current copy honesty now applies despite B11 conditional motion label. Existing local passes, historicaldirtydist identity and exact live release are separated. Human/device/motion/inspection tests remain unknown or conditional, not fresh failures.
